breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: both periodic and Dirichlet (u=0). The ground truth resolved this by keeping only the periodic condition, which is consistent with the domain definition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and its generated specification only lists 'Periodic wrap-around' as the boundary condition, successfully removing the incorrect Dirichlet condition.
